name: Switch scheme mid-flow (NPS → VPF)
goal: User starts opting in to NPS, then changes their mind to VPF mid-flow. The bot must switch or cleanly clarify — not stay stuck in NPS or break.
constraints: General edge case: the user changes intent mid-conversation. The bot should handle the switch gracefully, never run on stale intent.

phases.verbatimUserMessage: I want to opt in to NPS
phases.completionCriteria: Bot starts the NPS opt-in flow (shows the NPS intro / asks to proceed).

phases.verbatimUserMessage: Actually, I want to opt in to VPF instead
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes the changed intent and switches to the VPF flow (or clearly asks to confirm the switch); it does NOT keep running the NPS flow as if nothing changed.
